brief: Identify which beneficiary and account records need review after a major life change.

en-US.scenario: Fictional US-dollar examples for "Review Beneficiaries"; illustrative amounts, not current prices or product offers. No assumption of salary, bank ownership or spare income.

es-MX.scenario: Ejemplos ficticios en pesos mexicanos para "Revisa personas y registros"; montos ilustrativos, no precios vigentes ni ofertas. No se supone nómina, cuenta bancaria ni dinero sobrante.

pt-BR.scenario: Exemplos fictícios em reais para "Confira pessoas e registros"; valores ilustrativos, não preços atuais nem ofertas. Sem supor salário, conta bancária ou dinheiro sobrando.

objective.observable_action: Identify which beneficiary and account records need review after a major life change.
objective.success_criterion: Complete the fresh-context transfer using only its visible information.

instruction.relevance: A major life change can make account contacts and beneficiary records outdated.
instruction.misconception: A marriage, separation or death automatically updates every financial account and beneficiary designation.
instruction.numeracy_support: Use only the visible fictional amounts and conditions; earlier arithmetic is preparation, not a hidden financial assumption.

evidence.reasoning: After major life changes, check beneficiaries and contacts through the provider’s official process. Verify legal effects locally.
Outdated contacts can impair account communication and administration.
A life event does not prove every designation was updated.
Confirmation connects the request with the account’s actual record.
Separate accounts can maintain separate designations.
Conflicting legal effects require relevant local clarification.
The event calls for checking actual records and applicable procedures.

delayed_retrieval.fresh_context: Retrieve this competence in the declared later course reviews and through the existing shared review system.

en-US.line: A major life change can make account contacts and beneficiary records outdated.

es-MX.line: Tras un cambio importante, revisa beneficiarios y contactos mediante el proceso oficial del proveedor. Verifica localmente sus efectos legales.
